gse244832.allowed_use: Future development-only factor analysis at an explicit donor-by-cell-state pseudobulk unit. Different aliquots may share that aggregate sample label only when the topology is recorded; never pair individual cells.
gse244832.model_access: No champion or sealed evaluation. All included pseudobulk samples participate in the fitted factorization and are therefore transductively exposed.

gse289173.allowed_use: None. MOFA+ has no frozen assay-to-factor transform for an unseen RNA-only donor, and this sealed source cannot be inserted or refit.
gse289173.model_access: No features, rows, labels, covariates, or outcomes may enter a MOFA+ fit.

gse296875.allowed_use: Future nonpromotable development-only same-nucleus or donor-by-cell-state factor analysis after activation gates pass.
gse296875.model_access: Any included sample has a fitted Z and is transductively exposed. Donor-grouped descriptive resampling cannot convert this into inductive evaluation.

pairing_rules.gse244832: different aliquots may align only at a declared donor-by-cell-state pseudobulk sample unit
pairing_rules.gse289173: RNA_only sealed source excluded from MOFA+
pairing_rules.gse296875: same_nucleus rows or declared donor-by-cell-state pseudobulk samples

rules.biological_unit: Donors are inferential units; cells, fitted factor rows, and missing entries are not replicates.
rules.missingness: Use NaN plus MOFA mask for absent assays; never zero. Preserve project missingness reasons externally.
rules.profile_rule: WZ imputation for fitted samples is not an inductive RNA-conditioned ATAC profile.
rules.sealed_rule: No refitting, latent optimization, or masked-row insertion for GSE289173.
